meta_title: D&D Garden Services | Landscape Gardener Newcastle
meta_description: D&D Garden Services Newcastle. Expert landscape gardening, garden design, and maintenance. Local family business serving Tyne & Wear. Call now for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Local Landscape Experts — Free Quotes & Design Consultations
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to bespoke garden design, we create outdoor spaces you'll love using sustainable, local expertise.
services_heading: Complete Garden Services Across Newcastle & Tyne & Wear
services_subhead: We handle everything from initial design right through to planting, paving, and year-round maintenance — backed by expert horticulture knowledge.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create detailed plans that transform tired gardens into outdoor living spaces you'll use every season.

services.title: Paving & Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Professional patios, driveways, pathways, and raised beds using quality materials. Properly laid foundations ensure surfaces last 15+ years without cracking or settling.

services.title: Planting & Garden Installation
services.desc: Expert selection and positioning of trees, shrubs, and perennials suited to Newcastle's climate. We establish strong root systems and ongoing care schedules from day one.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Maintenance
services.desc: Overgrown borders? Shed removal? Regular grass cutting and hedge trimming. We'll clear the mess, then keep your garden thriving year-round with tailored maintenance plans.

services.title: Decking & Garden Structures
services.desc: Quality-built decking, pergolas, arbours, and seating areas. All structures are treated for longevity and designed to blend seamlessly with your garden layout.

services.title: Drainage & Soil Solutions
services.desc: Poor drainage killing your plants? We install permeable paving, French drains, and soil amendments to resolve waterlogging and create healthy growing conditions.

about_pullquote: We build gardens people actually want to spend time in — not just look at.
about_para_1: D&D Garden Services was founded 18 years ago on a simple belief: a great garden improves your whole quality of life. What started as one person with a vision has grown into a trusted team serving hundreds of Newcastle families and businesses. We combine horticultural training with practical craftsmanship — whether we're designing from scratch or rescuing a neglected space.
about_para_2: Our customers come back year after year because we listen first, deliver on time, and stand behind our work. We're not landscape designers who disappear after planting; we're committed to helping your garden thrive through every season. Most of our work comes from referrals and repeat customers — a testament to the relationships we build.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had a nightmare of a back garden — just weeds and broken paving. Dave and the team came in, cleared it all, laid a new patio, and planted it up beautifully. The design consultation was free and they listened to exactly what we wanted. Brilliant job and genuinely fair prices.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Couldn't recommend D&D more. They came out to quote for routine maintenance and noticed our drainage was terrible. They didn't just fix it — they explained what was happening and why. Six months on and the garden looks healthier than ever. Real professionals.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Absolute game-changer. Our front and back were completely overgrown. They cleared everything in a day, built a pergola, laid turf and borders. The aftercare advice was spot on. They came back in spring to check the planting was thriving. Top blokes.
reviews.author: Robert K.
